Class ImageCache

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.view.gui.ImageCache
public class ImageCache extends Object
Caches and provides access to all image assets used by the GUI. Images are loaded on demand and stored in an internal map to avoid repeated disk I/O. Provides specialized rendering methods for cards, totems, rules pages, the summary card, and prestige point indicators.

  • Method Details

    • renderCards

      public javafx.scene.image.Image renderCards(String cardId)
      Loads and returns the image for the card identified by the given ID. The card's resource path is resolved through the internal path map and cached after the first load.
      Parameters:
      cardId - the identifier of the card to render
      Returns:
      the card Image, or null if the card ID is unknown or the resource is missing

    • preloadRules

      public List<javafx.scene.image.Image> preloadRules()
      Preloads all rules explanation pages (1 through 8) using background loading to avoid UI freezes.
      Returns:
      a list of Images for each rules page that was successfully loaded

    • renderSummaryCard

      public List<javafx.scene.image.Image> renderSummaryCard()
      Loads and returns the front and back images of the summary card. Results are cached after the first load.
      Returns:
      a list with two elements: [front, back]

    • renderPrestige

      public javafx.scene.image.Image renderPrestige(boolean negative)
      Loads and returns the prestige points icon. A different image is returned when prestige is negative.
      Parameters:
      negative - whether the player's prestige points are below zero
      Returns:
      the prestige icon Image

    • renderTotem

      public javafx.scene.image.Image renderTotem(String color)
      Loads and returns the totem image for the given color. The result is cached after the first load.
      Parameters:
      color - the totem color name (e.g. "blue", "red")
      Returns:
      the totem Image
